problem_type: Cross-component whole-viewport duplicate identity header and duplicate isomorphic action bar
symptom: On the 1440x900 generation canvas empty state with the resident Agent dock open and no model connected, two [N] Nomi headers appear ~22px apart at the top of the Agent dock, and two identical 7-item node-creation surfaces (central starter tiles and bottom floating toolbar) appear simultaneously on the empty canvas.
direct_cause: 1) NoTextModelRecoveryCard retained a pre-v4 NomiIdentityRow header inside a card mounted directly beneath AgentPanelV4Panel's permanent NomiBrand header. 2) GenerationCanvasReactFlow mounted CanvasToolbar whenever !readOnly regardless of nodes.length, while GenerationCanvasReactFlowOverlays mounted CanvasEmptyState when nodes.length === 0. 3) _feel.mjs and _feel-observer.mjs lacked whole-viewport rules for container-header duplication and isomorphic action bars.
class_root: Component-isolated rendering and unit tests validate each subtree's local header or action list without a shared exclusivity boundary for empty-vs-populated workspace chrome or a whole-viewport structural duplicate detector.
affected_population: All new or unconfigured creators opening the resident Agent panel without a text model
All creators opening a blank generation canvas or deleting the last node in a category (0 nodes)
entry_points: ProjectAgentResidentShell mounts NoTextModelRecoveryCard inside AgentPanelV4Panel (emptyOverride and flowTail)
GenerationCanvasReactFlow and GenerationCanvasReactFlowOverlays mount CanvasToolbar and CanvasEmptyState on the generation canvas
installFeelObserver and scanFeel inspect full-viewport DOM geometry on screenshots and state waits
internal_only_reason: Panel header ownership, empty-vs-populated canvas toolbar exclusivity, and the generic DOM feel scanner are internal UI composition invariants of this repository.
invariants: Inside AgentPanelV4Panel, the panel header is the sole Nomi brand header; recovery and pointer cards in the flow body never render a second Nomi identity row.

On the generation canvas, interactive creation surfaces are mutually exclusive: readOnly renders neither, nodes.length === 0 renders only CanvasEmptyState, and nodes.length > 0 renders only CanvasToolbar while preserving CanvasNavigationStack.

Full-viewport feel scans detect container-header duplication (duplicate-nearby-header) and non-item isomorphic action bars (duplicate-action-bar) with zero budget on ratchet journeys and zero product-specific selectors.

door_reduction.why_not: ProjectAgentResidentShell is already the single host of NoTextModelRecoveryCard; GenerationCanvasReactFlow (populated dock), GenerationCanvasReactFlowOverlays (empty starter and context NodeAddMenu), CanvasEmptyState/CanvasToolbar (shared CanvasMoreAddMenu), and the Design Lab specimen screen serve distinct UI surfaces, while empty-vs-populated creation surface visibility is now governed by one shared resolveCanvasCreationSurface predicate.

generality_proof: Removing NomiIdentityRow from NoTextModelRecoveryCard eliminates duplicate panel identity across all three recovery card states; gating CanvasEmptyState and CanvasToolbar through resolveCanvasCreationSurface makes co-mounting structurally impossible for any category or node mutation; and generic DOM rules in scanFeel/_feel-observer catch any future panel/dialog duplicate header or duplicate stage toolbar across the entire app without product selectors.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single decision owner determining whether the empty-canvas starter row, the bottom floating toolbar, or neither (readOnly) may mount.
Renders model-missing pointer and one-click recovery cards inside AgentPanelV4Panel without duplicating the panel header's Nomi identity.
Scans any rendered viewport for duplicate-nearby-header and duplicate-action-bar using pure DOM geometry and accessible semantics.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All three branches (done, recoverable brain, and APIMart pointer) removed inner NomiIdentityRow headers so AgentPanelV4Panel header remains unique.
CanvasToolbar mounts only when resolveCanvasCreationSurface({ readOnly, nodeCount: nodes.length }) === 'toolbar'.
CanvasEmptyState interactive starter tiles mount only when resolveCanvasCreationSurface({ readOnly, nodeCount: nodes.length }) === 'empty-starter'.
Library already hides the top-right new-project button when empty starter cards are shown.

recurrence.reason: Independent subtrees (panel header vs empty/recovery card, empty-state overlay vs persistent bottom dock) routinely evolve in separate slices and pass isolated component tests unless enforced by shared state exclusivity and whole-viewport feel scanning.
same_class_scan: git grep NomiIdentityRow across src/: NoTextModelRecoveryCard.tsx was the sole production caller; V4AssistantMessage and V4EmptyState already omit per-row identity headers.

door-map on CanvasToolbar and CanvasEmptyState: GenerationCanvasReactFlow.tsx and GenerationCanvasReactFlowOverlays.tsx are the sole production canvas hosts; ProjectLibraryPage already enforces empty-vs-header button exclusivity.

prevention.invariant: Canvas creation surfaces are mutually exclusive via resolveCanvasCreationSurface in GenerationCanvasReactFlowOverlays, NoTextModelRecoveryCard never renders an inner Nomi header inside AgentPanelV4Panel, and _feel-observer ratchets duplicate-nearby-header and duplicate-action-bar at 0.
prevention.failure_mode: Unit tests fail if dual Nomi headers or dual creation toolbars co-render, and Playwright feel observer throws Feel baseline drift on any ratchet checkpoint with duplicate nearby headers or isomorphic action bars.
prevention.strategy: Consolidate creation-surface visibility into resolveCanvasCreationSurface and a single GenerationCanvasReactFlowOverlays branch, delete inner NomiIdentityRow usage in NoTextModelRecoveryCard, and enforce generic viewport-wide duplicate header/toolbar detection in _feel.mjs and _feel-observer.mjs.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed legacy pre-v4 NomiIdentityRow headers inside NoTextModelRecoveryCard and removed unconditional CanvasToolbar mounting on 0-node empty canvases.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party package controls panel header deduplication, empty-canvas toolbar gating, or DOM geometry scanning.

migration: No persisted project data, catalog records, or user preferences change shape; walkthrough helper canvasAddBar in tests/ux/_shell.mjs resolves the active creation surface across 0-node and >=1-node states.
residual_risks: Record-mode ad-hoc walkthroughs outside catalog ratchet journeys write duplicate-nearby-header and duplicate-action-bar findings to new-surfaces.json rather than throwing immediately, while smoke and catalog journeys throw immediately at budget 0.
